title: Euphemism
skills: identify euphemistic expressions in speech and writing
analyze how euphemisms soften or obscure meaning
evaluate how euphemistic language influences tone and audience response
alignment_note: Reinforces euphemism as the use of milder or indirect expressions in place of language that may seem harsh, uncomfortable, or sensitive. Supports analysis of connotation, tone, rhetorical effect, media language, and deliberate word choice across high school English courses.
